question: How should open decisions be shown and answered inside the Claude Code terminal/plugin?
context: Today agency_propose_decision only saves a decision; the user must open the GUI Decisions tab or reply in chat, then the AI calls agency_get_decision with choose. Goal: native Claude Code question UI like AskUserQuestion, so picking happens in the terminal.

options.name: AI asks via AskUserQuestion
options.what_it_is: After propose_decision, the AI calls Claude Code's built-in AskUserQuestion with the options, then records the pick via agency_get_decision choose. Driven by skill instructions.
options.how_it_fits_here: Edit skills/agency/SKILL.md and propose_decision's return text in src/mcp.js to say: ask via AskUserQuestion (recommended first, pros/cons in descriptions), pass choose. No new server logic.
cons: Relies on the AI following instructions
Claude Code only; other clients fall back to chat

options.name: MCP elicitation
options.what_it_is: The server itself asks the client to show a form (MCP elicitation) from inside propose_decision and records the answer automatically.
options.how_it_fits_here: In src/mcp.js call server.server.elicitInput with an enum of option names plus summary text; on accept save choice via S.saveDecision. GUI answers must race/cancel it.
pros: Works in any client supporting elicitation
cons: Form shows less detail than AskUserQuestion
Tool call blocks while waiting; races with GUI answer

recommendation.why: Gives the richest native terminal prompt with one small edit to skill and mcp text, with no blocking or GUI race in the server.
recommendation.would_change_mind_if: AI often skips asking, then add elicitation as enforced fallback.
